title: OddSense's Revamped Glow Lichen
description: Give glow lichen a vanilla style revamp to avoid mistaking them for diamonds
body:
Changes the glow lichen texture to be similar to the hanging roots texture as to stay consistent to vanilla, while no longer being easily confused for diamonds

Changes ONLY the glow lichen texture

https://www.youtube.com/@OdSens
